## Discovered from

rebar-debug on bug `masonic-abeyant-stagbeetle` (3a52-2d79-320d-4fed). This gap directly
lengthened that investigation.

## Problem

`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:257` emits a countable `AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE` journal marker
whenever `reclaim_under_pressure` fires, but `infra/scripts/observability.sh` publishes no
metric for it. Story `sour-plugugly-rhino` (28f9-535c-ce9c-4583) scoped that out on purpose:
"The new `AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE` marker is intentionally NOT wired to a new CloudWatch
metric in this story ... Wiring an observability delta metric for it is deferred as out of
scope."

Consequence: whether the pressure-prune actually fired, and how often, is readable **only** from
the host journal. During the 2026-08-17 root-disk incident that made a first-order question —
"did the reclaim gate run at all?" — unanswerable from CloudWatch, and the answer had to be
inferred indirectly from `deploy_deferrals` plus the code's branch structure. A debugging
session without `ssm:SendCommand` cannot answer it at all.

Every sibling autodeploy marker already has a metric: `AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED` →
`deploy_deferrals`, `AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT` → `review_interrupts` (+ the two
reason-scoped counters), `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` → `deploy_errors`. This one is the odd one out.

## Approach

`observability.sh` already has the exact helper: `publish_autodeploy_marker_delta` with a
record-anchored ERE, an offset file, and a dimensionless `put-metric-data`. Add one call site
alongside the existing three:

```
publish_autodeploy_marker_delta '^AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE \{' disk_pressure_prunes \
  "$DISK_PRESSURE_OFFSET_FILE" "auto-deploy disk-pressure prunes"
```

plus the offset-file variable and its `mkdir -p`, matching the existing block.

No alarm is proposed: the outcome is already alarmed by `rebar-root-disk-pressure`. This is a
diagnostic counter, so that a future incident can distinguish "the reclaim gate never ran" from
"it ran and reclaimed nothing" — the exact distinction that cost the most time on 3a52.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `rebar/host:disk_pressure_prunes` is published dimensionless by `observability.sh`, using
      the existing `publish_autodeploy_marker_delta` helper and a record-anchored pattern —
      verified by `tests/scripts/test_observability_disk_pressure.py`, a harness in the `test_observability_interrupt_reasons.py` style that drives the REAL script over a synthetic journal asserting the call site exists with the anchored
      ERE and its own offset file.
- [x] The counter seeds to 0 on first run rather than publishing the inherited journal count,
      matching the other marker counters — verified by the same test module.
- [x] `docs`/runbook note that the counter distinguishes "gate did not run" from "gate ran and
      reclaimed nothing" — verified by the runbook diff.
